description: Use this when the user wants a mind map, concept map, brainstorm map or topic tree drawn from an outline or a list of topics and subtopics, for example "turn these notes into a mind map" or "mind map of our launch plan". Takes an indented outline (2 spaces or 1 tab per level) or nested nodes, up to 300 topics and 6 levels, plus a layout (balanced, right-tree or org-down), a colour theme and a PDF page size. Returns the topic count, depth, main branches, an interactive map, and SVG, PDF and OPML downloads. Refuses mixed indentation and skipped levels with the line number. Does not draw flowcharts with decisions, timelines, images or links between branches, and does not save maps.

layout.description: balanced (default): main branches split to the left and right of the centre topic; right-tree: everything grows to the right; org-down: a top-down hierarchy like an org chart.

nodes.description: Alternative to outline_text. Nested topics: [{"text":"Goals","children":[{"text":"Revenue"},{"text":"Hiring"}]}]. Each node has text (up to 120 characters) and optional children. Up to 300 nodes and 6 levels.

outline_text.description:
Indented outline, one topic per line, 2 spaces (or 1 tab) per level, optional "-" bullets, e.g. "Marketing
  - Social
  - Email
Sales
  - Partners". Up to 300 lines and 6 levels. Give this or nodes.

page_size.description: PDF page: auto (default, the page fits the map at full size), letter or a4 (the map is scaled to fit one page, landscape or portrait).

theme.description: Colour theme, e.g. classic (default, a colour per branch), ocean (blues), forest (greens and browns) or mono (grey, prints well in black and white).

title.description: Centre topic of the map, e.g. "Product launch". If omitted and the outline has one top line, that line becomes the centre.

name: generate_mind_map
title: Generate mind map
